name: Honed Edge
prompt:
Create one finished AshenSpire card artwork illustration. Style reference ONLY: attached image; do not copy its knight into unrelated cards. Exact card identity: Honed Edge (honedEdge), colorless skill. Canonical action: Gain {strength} Strength. Exhaust. [{"op":"applyStatus","target":"self","status":"strength","stacks":2}]. Lore/mood: Whetstone from the cairn.

At the Grave of the Nameless, the custom is to take one and leave one. The stones are weald sandstone, marches slate, black glass of the reach. One is starstone.

Within the year, someone always carries it back.. Illustrate that specific action or concept clearly in a grounded ruined medieval dark fantasy world. For rogue cards use a weathered hooded agile rogue and correct weapons; equipment technique must depict the named weapon (unarmed means empty hands, bow means bow and arrow, staff means a long magical staff, sceptre a short ritual focus). Single coherent scene, anatomically correct hands and physically plausible weapons. Rich painted material detail, dramatic readable lighting, ash, old stone, worn iron, muted earth with appropriate restrained magical color. Composition portrait 2:3, 1024x1536. Main focal action below the upper third, with ample detailed background/sky/ruins ABOVE and around it for user repositioning and mouse cropping. Avoid subject clipping and excessive closeup. No card frame, text, letters, numbers, icons, UI, parchment, watermarks, or collage. Not graphic gore; show combat through movement, sparks and spell effects. Final production artwork.
